description: This file is a PHP source file for the ACL Roles editing interface in the SuiteCRM project. It contains PHP code that manages the display and processing of the role editing form, including setting up templates, retrieving role data, and assigning variables for rendering the view.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering HTML templates with assigned variables.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for retrieving bean instances, specifically ACLRoles in this context.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Class providing static methods related to ACL action categories, such as setting up categories matrix.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the role bean object into an associative array for template assignment.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of actions associated with a specific role ID.

methods.name: setupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Sets up and returns a matrix of categories for ACL actions.
